verdict_rule: hyp_cells.verdict: design fold fixes the sign; confirm fold decides. CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE = confirm mean > 0, t >= 2, design mean > 0; FAILED_VARIANT = confirm mean <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE <= effect worth having; else CANNOT_DISTINGUISH. SE over date blocks, MDE = 2.8 SE.

cells.title: Hospital read-through after insurer denial policy shift
cells.refutation: No hospital-vs-insurer spread on the day after the policy announcement beyond XLV beta.
cells.separation_from_beta: Hospital basket vs insurer basket long-short; XLV beta cancels.

cells.title: Airline fuel hedge gap after crude spike
cells.refutation: No hedge-ratio-sorted return spread among airlines in the 5 days after a crude shock beyond XAL beta.
cells.separation_from_beta: Within-airline long-short on hedge ratio; sector and market beta cancel.

cells.title: Utility equity lag after power price spike
cells.refutation: No open-to-close spread between merchant and regulated utilities on the day after a power price shock beyond XLU beta.
cells.separation_from_beta: Merchant vs regulated utility spread controls for rates and broad utility beta.
